schemes.coord_method: Building parts from planning drawings and published promotional material (see Parts sheet for each part's basis).
schemes.facade: Anodised aluminium twisted vertical fins (undulating texture) wrapping the west, south and east facades over a light-blue extruded metal mesh ground floor with coloured frames to the vehicle and pedestrian entrances (Stuart Street); vertical and horizontal planted trellis on the north facade; three open stair cores (orange-lined) rising above the roof, one carrying vertical 'MERMAID QUAY' lettering; painted motifs on crash mesh and a mural on the east return.
schemes.form_notes: Long low box (c.115 m along Stuart Street) with split-level decks (ground + 4 levels at 2.75 m), open top deck with 1.3 m parapet, and a 41 x 16 m extension north at the east end; stair/lift cores to c.14.4 m (scaled off the 2024 section; positions not fixed, not modelled). The 2024 variation switched from extending the 1999 2-deck structure to near-total demolition and a system-build frame, +2.3 m at the front and +1.6 m at the rear. OSM: construction=parking 'Mermaid Quay Multistorey Car Park Rebuild', opening_date 2026-04.

schemes.name: Atlantic Wharf - Cardiff Arena (Phase 1, full permission)
schemes.uses: Multi-use indoor arena (D2) with cafe (A3), plaza over closed part of Hemingway Road (existing Travelodge demolished)
schemes.coord_method: Building parts from planning drawings and published promotional material (see Parts sheet for each part's basis).
schemes.facade: Bronze-coloured aluminium: dark bronze patina standing-seam and metal-clad composite panels (perforated and solid) over a fully glazed ground-floor base on the south (plaza) front; light gold anodised soffit and the curved 'Swoop' feature panel sweeping down across the south facade to frame the entrance; c.250 m2 LED media wall at the SE corner of the south front; on east and west sides two translucent laminated-glass curtain-wall 'arches' each (14 m high x 42 m wide and 8 m x 39 m), lit for events; north elevation solid dark bronze with a green screen; roof crown in dark standing seam with roof lights and PV.
schemes.form_notes: Rectangular box 148 x 92 m (long axis c.24 deg west of north, plaza to the south on the closed Hemingway Road). Three-part massing: (1) main box to a 24.2 m facade parapet (behind it a perimeter roof at L03 +28.96 AOD); (2) a set-back standing-seam crown over the bowl, 73 m wide, rising to 29.8 m (+40.4 m AOD), with a very shallow E-W fall; (3) a low north service / back-of-house wing (33 m) whose roof falls from c.12 m to c.8-9 m, with the service yard entrance at its NE corner. Ground floor L00 +10.600 m AOD. The 2023 redesign (23/01705/VAR) cut the 2022 HOK scheme from 162.3 x 101.5 m and +46.9 m AOD to 148 x 92 m and +40.4 m AOD, removed the angular overhangs and chamfered south corners, and moved the south front c.5.5 m north. Steel frame topped out 2026 (construction photos in report s93697 Figs 2-3); opening 2028.
